sentences.text: ...Responde Coram Hon'ble Mr. Justice Ajay Mohan Goel, Judge
Whether approved for reporting?1
Yes For the petitioners : Mr. Ajay Sharma, Senior  Advocate, with Mr. Atharv  Sharma, Advocate.

For the respondents : Mr. Pushpinder Jaswal,
 Additional Advocate General.
Ajay Mohan Goel, Judge (Oral)

By way of this writ petition, the petitioners have, inter alia, prayed for the following relief:-
"a) That impugned act of the respondents, above-stated, may very kindly be quashed and set aside with directions to the respondents to act in accordance with law in acquiring the land with respect to which petitioners have been divested of holding the land contrary to Article 300- A of the Constitution of India."
2. The grievance of the petitioners is that in the course 1Whether reporters of the local papers may be allowed to see the judgment?
2025:HHC:5926 of the construction of the channelization of a khud/river, details whereof are mentioned in the writ petition, in District Una, certain land of the petitioners comprised in Khasra No. 151 to the extent of 00-08-63 hectares, has been utilized, without acquiring the same in accordance with law and without compensating the petitioners.
It is in this backdrop that the petitioners have approached this Court, praying for the relief, enumerated hereinabove.

sentences.text:
The factum of the utilization of the land has not been denied by the respondents, but in terms of the reply filed by the State, their stand is that the part of land which has come within the standard width taken for channelization, is barren land and has no agricultural use and, therefore, if in such cases, the State starts granting compensation, it will increase the project cost many folds and the very object behind execution of the project would be defeated.
4.
Learned Additional Advocate General has also addressed his arguments on the same ground.

5. Having heard learned Senior Counsel for the petitioners as well as learned Additional Advocate General and 2025:HHC:5926 taking into consideration the fact that the utilization of the land of the petitioners has not been disputed by the respondents, I am of the considered view that the respondents cannot deny compensation thereof to the petitioners.
It is a settled law that no one can utilize the land of any individual, without compensating him as per law..

6. In terms of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India, onus is much more heavy upon the State that it cannot be allowed to utilize the land of the individual, without acquiring the same and compensating the land owner, in accordance with law.

Simply because the land is being utilized for a public purpose cannot be taken as a shield by the State for denying compensation to the land owner, because in every case where the State utilizes the property, it is for public purpose.

7. Accordingly, in the light of the above observations and in light of the fact that utilization of the land of the petitioners has not been denied by the respondents-State, this writ petition is allowed, by directing the respondents to acquire the land of the petitioners, which stand utilized for the purpose 2025:HHC:5926 of the construction of the channelization of a khud/river, in accordance with law and pay adequate compensation to the petitioners.
Acquisition proceedings be completed, within a period of four months from today.
Pending miscellaneous application(s), if any, also stand disposed of accordingly.

(Ajay Mohan Goel) Judge March 10, 2025 (Shivank Thakur)
